title: GROZ Coolant Mixer with Mixing Ratio Control Knob| Ideal for uniform blending of metal cutting fluids etc. with water| Portable Design| Maintenance Free |Mixing Ratio: 0 to 11%| CMX/SS/1
description: GROZ Coolant Mixer is an ideal solution for accurate and uniform blending of metal cutting fluids etc. with water for supply to machines. It can be used in industrial applications, garages, motor workshops for mixing of detergents, antifreeze etc. It works on a venturi mechanism driven by pressure from water supply, hence no external power source is required. It has compact aluminium body and stainless steel rotary disc valve that impart high strength and corrosion resistance properties, making it durable. It is a time and cost saving alternative to manual blending which provides reliable performance over the time. Water Inlet: 1/2" Female Mixing Ratio: 0 to 11% Flow Rate: 1100 Litres / Hour Wetted Components: Aluminium, Stainless Steel, Brass, Acetal, PVC and Nitrile Rubber Recommended Use: Cutting / Metal Working Fluids, Soy & other vegetable esters
